Take the Wheel

Drivers

I publish one feature a month. Usually, I will reach out to those I want to interview. However, I am also taking requests. Ask me to interview someone by filling out this form. If you would like to be interviewed, fill out and email me the Driver’s Survey.

Secret Surveys

There are throwback Myspace bulletin board surveys scattered through out the site. Submitted responses are considered for publication.

Trunk Content

Provenance

I try my best to ask permission from and credit the original creator for their content. That said, with the nature of the web, it is not always possible to trace provenance that far.

The artifacts I choose to publish are found online, presumably posted for public consumption. They are tagged with the most authentic information I could find.

Revisions

All content in the Trunk is open to suggestions and/or requests for revisions or alterations. Please email me for further discussion.

Transparency

What am I doing with all this material?

For right now, collecting. Building an archive of millennial memory.

I am not associated with any thing or any one. I am a single person with a special interest.

Do I pay for content?

No. I can’t pay for content.

Ya’ll already gave it away anyway, for free!

I give credit where credit is due tho

Do I pay anyone at all?

Yes. I’ll slip you a twenty for gas if you drive.
